### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **36** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **5** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/automation.json`, `packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/automation.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**19** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5f6c2f1952355504a7db5a956c4a86c11feefd57`.

⛔ **3** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **5** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/automation.json`, `packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/automation.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **4** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **150** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5f6c2f1952355504a7db5a956c4a86c11feefd57` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `40747ff652441683fa943178097b8d5e47b3b556` — the merge of head `a23235a99f05e66fbe60a06891c5aa43b75354eb` into base `5f6c2f1952355504a7db5a956c4a86c11feefd57`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 40747ff652441683fa943178097b8d5e47b3b556 && git checkout 40747ff652441683fa943178097b8d5e47b3b556
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 5f6c2f1952355504a7db5a956c4a86c11feefd57 a23235a99f05e66fbe60a06891c5aa43b75354eb && git checkout -B drift-repro 5f6c2f1952355504a7db5a956c4a86c11feefd57 && git merge --no-ff a23235a99f05e66fbe60a06891c5aa43b75354eb

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5f6c2f1952355504a7db5a956c4a86c11feefd57
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 5f6c2f1952355504a7db5a956c4a86c11feefd57` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

**Re-timed to 18.x (a triage note for this draft).** Triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-21T01:38Z

The maintainer amended 「甲」 (#6015 `6303865025`): 「暂时不考虑 v19，协议的调整原则上也是尽快，不考虑退役版本」, then confirmed triage's re-timing list in the triage seat's chat (「18.x 收回清单 同意」).

- **For this PR:** the section "every finding is a warning … the refusals wait for protocol 19" no longer holds.
- **Under the amendment:** the bulk `confirmText` findings (unbound root, single-brace token, hole compile error, blank) ship as **errors** in this PR, and the blank-string arm of `BulkConfirmTextSchema` is dropped here, as a BREAKING minor (the #24813 changeset shape).
- **No 19.0 card is filed** for the flip.
- **Before arming:** measure the producers (HotCRM, the examples) and fix any bulk action whose `confirmText` the errors would refuse.

## Takeover round · head `a23235a99f`

Taken over at the maintainer's word (os-bill, 2026-10-23T06:43Z). The seat 3 session's last report (`6341399560` on #24798) was `blocked`: its fix for the contract-review finding sat in two unpushed commits, refused by `check:commit-card-trailers`, and that container is gone. This round redoes the fix from scratch on top of `823f523b15`.

**The finding.** `translateBulkActionDefs` (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`) decided a `confirmText` override with `valueOverridesPackagedBase`, which compares strings. A served view and its packaged base can now each hold the parsed `{ dialect: 'template', source }` envelope. So an edited envelope lost to the catalog, and a bare string never matched a parsed packaged sentence.

**The fix** (`00012f791c`): both sides go through `templateSlotSource` before the comparison. An unchanged envelope still takes the catalog, an edited envelope keeps the authored sentence, and a bare string matches an envelope with the same source. `BulkActionDefLike.confirmText` is widened to `string | { dialect: 'template'; source }`. The changeset now reads `Metadata-protocol: semantic`, matching the body, and gains one bullet on served translations.

**Pins:** 3 in `i18n-resolver.test.ts` (ADR-0029 D9.2a block), 1 in `i18n-resolver.object-list-views.test.ts`, and 1 in `packages/rest/src/meta-view-container-i18n.test.ts`. These files are outside the claim's listed paths. They are forced by the slot change, the same way `i18n-extract.ts` was.

**Then** `origin/main` `5e772c79bf` merged in (`a23235a99f`, clean).

**Measured on the merged tree:**
- spec: `src/system/i18n-resolver*.test.ts` + `src/ui`: 154 files, 5994 passed. `typecheck` exit 0, `check:generated` exit 0, build exit 0.
- lint: 156 files, 7193 passed.
- rest `meta-view-container-i18n.test.ts`: 11 passed.
- **Ablation:** I reverse-applied the resolver hunk, then restored it, and the blob went back to `2956a32125af`. 3 of the 4 new spec pins went red. The fourth, "unedited envelope still gets the catalog", stays green either way, as expected: a non-string authored value already fell to the catalog.

The full suites are left to CI. Labelled `needs:contract-review` for the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review on this head.

Local-runs: none

The remainder (content/docs/references/ui/*.mdx regenerated tables, packages/qa/dogfood/test/expression-conformance.ledger.ts, the lint wiring and runtime-gate rule-list pins, action-confirm-params-guard.test.ts, component-props-unknown-members.pin.test.ts) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at TIER_DEFAULT.

Inputs read: card #24798 body and all 12 comments (ruling 6285948976; the amended 「甲」 pointer 6303865025 on #6015; seat hold 6296947690; dev reports 6296915438, 6339482401, 6341399560; takeover 6359413741; handover 6359795105), PR #24947 body, its 29-file list and net diff against main, its 3 comments (triage re-timing note 6305878399, takeover round 6359412711), card #25205, and the 47 check-runs on the head (every run is success or skipped; none failed; Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Changeset, Type Check, Lint and Test Core all success; Console Pin Gate skipped as opt-in).

### ① Derived judgments

1. Parse accept set of `BulkActionDefSchema.confirmText` (bulk-action.zod.ts): before, any string. After: any non-blank string (normalised to `{ dialect: 'template', source }`), a blank string verbatim (the second union arm, `z.string().regex(/^\s*$/)`), and a `dialect: 'template'` envelope. A foreign-dialect envelope and a non-string are refused with the slot's own sentence prescribing `{{ count }}`; both were refused by `z.string()` before, so nothing an author could write is refused now that passed before. A pure widening. RIGHT. Pinned in bulk-confirm-template.test.ts (bare string, envelope, holeless sentence, blank, foreign dialect, near-miss keys).
2. Parsed and served shape: a non-blank `confirmText` now parses to the envelope; `BulkActionDefParsed.confirmText` widens from `string` to `string | envelope` (the blank arm keeps `string` in the union). `BulkActionDef` is `z.input`, so the authoring type only gains the envelope. The changeset's "Parsed shape" bullet declares it. Every in-repo reader of a parsed bulk `confirmText` was found and judged: i18n-resolver.ts (fixed, item 6), cli i18n-extract.ts (fixed, item 7), lint validate-expressions.ts (reads through `templateSlotSource`). The other `confirmText` hits (metadata-protocol protocol.ts:817, platform-objects translations, explain.ts) are the object/global action slot, not this one. The console reader is objectui#13319 at `cd14d8eeffe1`, carried by #25193 (`9057fd41f5`), which is an ancestor of this head; the head's `.objectui-sha` is `5fef032b1ada`, equal to main's. RIGHT.
3. Public surface: five new exports, exactly as api-surface and export-origins record them — `closedScopeTemplateRefusal`, `templateSlotSource`, `ClosedTemplateScope` (automation) and `BULK_CONFIRM_COUNT_ROOT`, `bulkConfirmTemplateRoots` (ui). `templateExpressionInput` stays package-internal (docblock edit only; no barrel change, no api-surface row). RIGHT.
4. The judge (flow-text-slot-template.ts): `closedScopeTemplateRefusal` reuses `singleBraceTokens`, the `HOLE` / `HOLE_PATH` grammar and the root reading (`pathRoot`), with the scope's roots in place of the engine's `$` set. The refactor of `doubled` to take a predicate and the extraction of `pathHoles` / `pathRoot` are verdict-preserving for the flow judge: `flowSpellable` is the old inline predicate verbatim, and `unboundRootHoles` yields the same holes. The control pin ("the flow judge is unchanged") holds it. One judge, no fork, as ruling item 1 binds. RIGHT.
5. The doors (validate-expressions.ts, authoring-rules.ts): the pass walks a view's `list` and `listViews`, the flattened list overlay and the ViewItem record, and an object's own `listViews`; on a `view` write it is the only pass (early return), on an object write it joins the object's own body. `runtimeTypes` adds `view`. Every finding is `severity: 'warning'`; runtime-gate.ts:1175 routes non-error severities to `advisories`, and the CLI validate/compile separate errors from warnings, so no door's accept set moves and no exit code changes. The gate pins drive the real dispatch with all three view-write shapes and assert `errors` empty. Consistent with `Clause-②: yes (widening)`. RIGHT as the contract is declared — see ③ item 5 for the ruling question it leaves open.
6. i18n-resolver.ts `translateBulkActionDefs`: the earlier FAIL finding (`valueOverridesPackagedBase` compared an envelope by reference, so an edited envelope lost to the catalog and a bare string never matched a parsed base) is answered: both sides pass through `templateSlotSource` before the comparison, with `BulkActionDefLike.confirmText` widened to `string | envelope`. An unchanged envelope takes the catalog, a diverged one keeps the authored envelope, bare-vs-parsed match by source. Output is mixed-shape (catalog string, else authored envelope), which the pinned console reads. Pinned in three files. RIGHT.
7. cli i18n-extract.ts `pushBulkActionDefs`: the envelope is seeded through `templateSlotSource`, identical to the bare string; pinned. RIGHT.
8. Declared scope and spelling: `bulkConfirmTemplateRoots(def)` returns `count` then params by `name`, bare, `count` winning over a param of that name. The ruling left the spelling to the PR; bare matches the flow scope's roots and HotCRM's 12 sentences, which are pinned clean in spec and lint tests (zh-CN included). The display-value rule ruling item 2 asks the spec PR to state is stated in the slot's describe and the changeset. RIGHT.
9. Generated artifacts: api-surface, export-origins and the three reference .mdx tables are regenerated and CI's generated check is green. The .mdx type cell renders `string | {...} | string` (the blank arm shows as a second `string`) — tooling output, cosmetic, non-blocking.

### ② Semver level

Changeset `.changeset/24798-bulk-confirm-template-slot.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor, `@objectstack/lint` minor, `@objectstack/cli` minor. Clause-②: yes (widening) — matches the diff: the accept set widens (envelope form), five exports are added, a new advisory pass runs, and nothing that passed is refused. Metadata-protocol: semantic — the diff both adds an accepted value (the envelope: `added`) and changes the meaning of a stored `{{count}}` from literal text to a filled hole (`semantic`); under the AGENTS.md precedence (narrowed over semantic over added) `semantic` is the right kind, and a kind takes at least minor on each package the diff moves. The PR body carries the same two lines. The packages touched only in test files (rest, qa/dogfood) publish nothing from this diff. No BREAKING banner and no ADR-0087 marker are owed on a widening. Check Changeset is green on the head. RIGHT.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. Earlier contract-review FAIL (one blocking finding, `translateBulkActionDefs` / `valueOverridesPackagedBase`, reported by seat 3 in 6341399560 and 6359795105): answered at this head, as ① item 6 reads it. Note that no earlier `## Contract review` record is on the card or the PR thread; the finding is known from the dev and takeover reports only, so this record is the first record on the PR.
2. Dev open question 1 (landing order, 6296915438): answered. objectui#13319 (the envelope reader) landed at `cd14d8eeffe1`, #25193 moved the pin and is an ancestor of this head; the pin has since moved on to `5fef032b1ada` on both main and this head. The reader's presence at the later pin is read from pin history, not measured here (Console Pin Gate is skipped on this head, opt-in).
3. Dev open question 2 (i18n extract and the envelope form): answered in this PR (claim extended to i18n-extract.ts, pinned).
4. Dev open question 3 (a 19.0 card for the refusal flip): superseded by the amended 「甲」 (6303865025: no 19.0 line). The refusal half is filed as #25205 (18.x, p1, pm:blocked, order after this PR).
5. ESCALATION — departure from the triage note on the PR (6305878399, 2026-10-21): that note applied the amended 「甲」 to this PR and said the bulk `confirmText` findings ship as errors IN THIS PR, the blank-string arm is dropped here, as a BREAKING minor, with no separate card. The head instead keeps every finding a warning, keeps the blank arm, declares a widening, and carries the refusal on #25205. The amendment's own words ("the warning half alone is no longer the 18.x deliverable") and ruling item 1 ("refused by name at validate, compile and the publish gate") both point at the refusal; the seat's split (advisory now, refusal as its own BREAKING minor next, the #25002 precedent) is a scheduling reading the dev made in f10bc73a0f and the seat confirmed in 6339482401 and 6359795105. No maintainer word on the card or the PR covers the split. This is a product/timing question for the maintainer (Tesla, os-tesla), not this review's to decide: either the split stands (this PR lands as the widening and #25205 flips to errors), or the refusal must be in this PR (then the changeset becomes Clause-②: no (narrowing), Metadata-protocol: narrowed, BREAKING minor with its ADR-0087 disposition, and the blank arm is decided here). The contract as declared at this head is correct either way; what the word decides is whether this head is the whole 18.x deliverable.
6. Metadata-protocol kind moved from `added` (dev round) to `semantic` (seat, 6359795105) — a seat call consistent with the AGENTS.md precedence rule; no escalation.
7. `Fixes #24798` closes the card at merge while objectui#13183 (the fill step) stays open and pm:blocked on this card — the PR body's reasoning (ruling D on #24591, split by repo; closing unblocks #13183) is consistent with ruling item 2, and the "Part-of PR must not also close its card" check is green. Non-blocking.
8. Translated bulk `confirmText` strings in translation bundles are not judged for holes; the dev named it as #24814's question and ruling item 1 binds the def's slot only. Non-blocking, carried by #24814.
9. A param named `count` is shadowed by the count root; documented in the slot and the function, 0 producers in the corpus. Non-blocking.

Reviewed-by: `session_01KQ2Gi2mpTFz92kJVK2tMw8`

## Maintainer ruling: the split stands · 2026-10-23T12:13Z

On the escalation in ③ item 5 of the contract-review record `6364081346` (warnings in this PR vs refusal in this PR), the maintainer (Tesla, `os-tesla`) chose **A** at 2026-10-23T12:12Z, in the project thread, on the card asking whether the refusal ships here or on #25205.

- **This PR lands as is:** every bulk `confirmText` finding stays a warning, the blank arm stays, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: semantic`.
- **#25205 follows right after**, in 18.x: it promotes the findings to errors at validate, compile and the publish gate as its own BREAKING minor, and decides the blank arm. It supersedes the "in this PR" reading of the triage note `6305878399`.

Landing now: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` on head `a23235a99f` (contract review PASS on this head, 47 check-runs green, not governed, 914 changed lines).
